blurb.text: A Portuguese wine region near Viseu that overlaps the Dão and Vinho Verde DOCs, known for acidic, light-bodied red and white wines. Allowed grapes include Arinto, Cercial and Rabo de Ovelha, and Touriga Nacional, Jaen and Amaral.
